title: Quadrilles and dance repertoire; playing with Perez and Kid Punch
summary: Keppard recalls card drills, mazurkas, lancers, and quadrilles at the halls and playing with Mal Perez and others.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets

blocks.x: that started up, I was a young man that time, you know, of course, I didn't mean to be 69 years old, won't mean to shave, I'll be glad, Mr. Russell. You don't look like that. Yeah, well, I'll be glad to see that, and experience life, and I know what it's all about, you know, of course, these days in time, well, everybody was free, everybody owned a penny, hot to play, hot not to play, well, you see, in them times, we used to play card drills, pokers, mazookas, lancers, shatters, and warsers. Of course, I don't hear the boys play that no more, see, Mr. Russell, I just don't hear them play that no more, because I know that, well, that was music sometimes, when they play, shatters, at 12 o'clock, we used to start them, them quadrilles, at the county hall, the copyrights hall, St. Elizabeth Hall, St. Dominic, and Newhall, well, I used to play all around in different places, with Malparez, Iain John Eastman, Kinoa, and all of them, well, I played with all them boys, Zachary's a player, on 3rd Street Day, at this, uh, place on 3rd, and, and Willow, that is his main word, with his father, they call, uh, I don't know where he's at now, but they told me, if you know, they call him, uh, uh, uh, Punch, Kid Punch. Kid Punch, he's in power now, well, he's in power, well, alright, well, of course, Kid Punch, he, he, he's a strong corner player, because I was playing out too, and Kid Punch taking the, he was playing with the brass band, in the, my brass band, I was playing alto too, you know, the brass band, Black Benny,
